scope: All five downloaded datasets under data/raw, plus external candidate sources researched for task readiness.
method: Counted local images, annotation files, split membership, and class-folder contents.
Paired GrainSet images and masks by basename.
Parsed Roboflow polygon and box label rows and class IDs.
Compared filename-derived capture groups across splits and SHA-256 image duplicates in the Roboflow exports.
Inspected the public Roboflow wheat-grain version card for license, class names, image count, and published splits.

graindet_rice_v2.format: PNG single-kernel images arranged in train/val/test and eight coded class folders; no separate annotation files.

group_audit.method: Filename prefix before the trailing grain index and _p600s suffix; proxy only, not publisher-provided group IDs.

blockers: Class-code semantics are not verified from an authoritative local codebook.
Filename-derived groups overlap across all splits.
No explicit sprouted or weevilled class is present; pest-attacked cannot be substituted for weevilled.
No non-rice images are available for rice_gate.

group_audit.method: Filename prefix before the trailing grain index and _p600s suffix; proxy only, not publisher-provided group IDs.

grainset_rice_v3.annotation_note: Figshare lists rice.xml as a separate downloadable file; it is absent from the local extraction.
grainset_rice_v3.license_note: Existing source audit records a conflict: Figshare API says CC BY 4.0; the project page says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
blockers: Every GrainDet basename is shared, so these corpora are not independent sources.
Single-kernel masks do not alone establish the project's bulk-scene instance-segmentation target.

murat_koklu_rice_image_dataset_v1.format: JPG images in five variety folders, 15000 per variety, plus publisher citation text.
blockers: Variety labels are not defect labels or rice/non-rice labels.
No physical source-group IDs or published splits.

roboflow_rice_grain_defects_v1.annotation_format: YOLO segmentation polygons, not bounding boxes.
roboflow_rice_grain_defects_v1.filename_group_overlap: None observed, but original capture groups are not published or verified.
blockers: Numeric class IDs have no names in data.yaml.
The unknown taxonomy does not establish a match to the project's defect or foreign-matter labels.

roboflow_rice_quality_parameters_v1.annotation_format: YOLO detection boxes; all rows parsed and paired with images.
roboflow_rice_quality_parameters_v1.filename_group_overlap: None observed, but original capture/lot groups are not published or verified.
blockers: Only 22 test images and no original source-group IDs.
foreign_object does not encode the project's stone/organic/inorganic taxonomy.
Boxes do not satisfy the mask input contract of the current chalky trainer.

roboflow_wheat_grain_gate_negatives_v1.source_group_metadata: No physical sample/acquisition groups verified on the public card.
blockers: Archive has not been downloaded or locally inspected.
Class balance and source-group independence are unknown.
The local rice-gate trainer does not implement real-image training/evaluation and raises NotImplementedError after manifest validation.

training_block_reason: No dataset passed the task-specific label, provenance, and split-safety gates. The rice-gate real-image training/evaluation implementation is also incomplete. Training from unapproved data would create unsupported model claims.
